review.note: ecc-rec-11-04 transcribed on 2026-11-07 from the ECC document database PDF (download 4842, edition 7 November 2025). A person still has to check every quoted value against the PDF pages and record their name and the date in verified_by.

criteria.title: ECC/REC/(11)04: cross-border coordination for MFCN in the band 791-862 MHz
criteria.citation: ECC/REC/(11)04 (amended 7 November 2025), Annex 1 Table 1 and Annex 2
criteria.edges: [791, 821] MHz inclusive: Annex 1 (page 5) gives the base-station field strengths for 791-821 MHz; 821-862 MHz is the FDD uplink (terminals), which has no base-station trigger
criteria.bw_correction_quote: Annex 1 (page 5): 'In cases of other frequency block sizes other than 5 MHz, a factor of 10 × log10 (channel bandwidth/5 MHz) should be added to the field strength values.'
criteria.propagation_quote: Annex 2 (page 7), Site General model: 'the basic model ... is Recommendation ITU-R P.1546. This model is to be employed for 50% locations, 10% time and using a receiver height of 3 m.'
criteria.evaluation_quote: Annex 1 Table 1 (page 6): '@ stands for "at a distance from the borderline into the neighbouring country"'; the assessed trigger is the one given '@ 0 km'.

bands.case: synchronisation signal centre frequencies aligned, non-preferential PCIs
bands.quote: Annex 1 (page 5): '41 dB(µV/m)/5 MHz at a height of 3 m above ground at the borderline between neighbouring countries.'

other_levels.case: centre frequencies not aligned, or aligned with preferential PCIs
other_levels.quote: Annex 1 (page 5): '59 dB(µV/m)/5 MHz at a height of 3 m above ground at the borderline between countries'

other_levels.case: centre frequencies not aligned, or aligned with preferential PCIs
other_levels.quote: Annex 1 (page 5): '41 dB(µV/m)/5 MHz at a height of 3 m above ground at a distance of 6 km inside the neighbouring country.'

criteria.selection_note: The notices do not say whether centre frequencies are aligned or which PCIs are used, so the most restrictive border level (41 dB(µV/m)/5 MHz @ 0 km) is assessed (assumption A-T-ECC-NONPREF). The 59 dB(µV/m) level is reported beside it.
